al_rdan: Marek Rdan unpacked a lucky button at U-F21. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.
A patient apologized for bleeding on Marek Rdan's sleeve. He told the patient to concentrate on staying awake.
Marek Rdan got a letter from Helene. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Marek Rdan in the open at U-F21. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Valentin "Saint" Poysner of the Concord (@poysner). Marek Rdan was killed on watch at U-F21. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Valentin "Saint" Poysner of the Concord (@poysner).
Norbert Rdan came to the front because his older brother Marek Rdan never came home. He carries a lucky button.

At U-F21 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Norbert Rdan won the bet. Roland "Bones" Poysner was badly wounded. Norbert Rdan was hit through the stomach at U-F21. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Anselm Ofsoup of the Concord (@sea_ofsoup). A single shot at U-F21. Norbert Rdan sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Anselm Ofsoup of the Concord (@sea_ofsoup).
The House of Rdan sent Oskar Rdan after Norbert Rdan. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
A bullet went through Oskar Rdan's sleeve at U-F21 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Hugo Poysner of the Concord (@poysner).
alejandrolopez.mora: On Day 14 Silas Mora took a post at V-F7 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He talks to his rifle, and the men liked him for it.
A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Silas Mora gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page.

The raid hit the Concord line at the darkest hour. Silas Mora fought Norbert Kevinw in a trench no wider than a door. Silas Mora came home with Norbert Kevinw's cap badge. (@kevinw224) Silas Mora was on the dawn watch at V-F7 when the Concord raiders came. A club, a shout, and Silas Mora was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Ulrich Vibzcolonydr of the Concord (@vibzcolonydrop).
dominiclong22nd: Day 11: Nils "Bones" Dominiclong reached P-F16 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Nils "Bones" Dominiclong folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

Nils "Bones" Dominiclong checked the fire step after the shelling. The wall had moved, and the spot where he always put his foot was gone. Mail came up the line with a letter for Nils "Bones" Dominiclong. Nils "Bones" Dominiclong read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Nils "Bones" Dominiclong was carrying water up to P-F16 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Nils "Bones" Dominiclong did not. Shot by Otto Lopez of the Concord (@manny_lopez.18). Mail came up the line with a letter for Nils "Bones" Dominiclong. Nils "Bones" Dominiclong read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Nils "Bones" Dominiclong asked the bearers for water and then for his mother. He died before either came.
Otto "Smokes" Dominiclong had heard about Nils "Bones" Dominiclong's courage. At P-F16, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

A bullet went through Otto "Smokes" Dominiclong's sleeve at P-F16 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Otto Lopez of the Concord (@manny_lopez.18). Mail came up the line with a letter for Otto "Smokes" Dominiclong. Otto "Smokes" Dominiclong read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Otto "Smokes" Dominiclong sat on an ammunition box at P-F16 with a bandaged leg and gave advice to everyone who passed. Nobody asked for it. A letter for Otto "Smokes" Dominiclong came all the way from home in nine days. Otto "Smokes" Dominiclong counted them on the envelope.
gabriello_princip: Wendel Princip, a glassblower from Belmonte, was sent forward on Day 9 to fill a gap in R-C5. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Wendel Princip watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Wendel Princip and Dietrich "Button" Cake argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war. The clerk counted the names twice. Wendel Princip is number 773 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill is lost. Wendel Princip heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Wendel Princip traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch.
The men have learned that Wendel Princip never sits with his back to the parapet. Tonight it made them laugh, which was worth a great deal.
The relief reached R-C5 without Wendel Princip. His name was added to a list the corporal kept separate from the dead.
Wendel Princip crawled back into R-C5 at dawn after two nights in a shell hole at Sorrow Copse, covered in mud and carrying a tin whistle. He asked if he had missed breakfast.
Wendel Princip smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Anselm Hohlmike came out for a cup and was badly wounded.
gabrielverberkmoes: Teodor "Spark" Gabrielverbe found a place in V-F1 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
A bullet grazed Teodor "Spark" Gabrielverbe's ribs at V-F1. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Florian Max of the Hegemony (@heger_max).
Teodor "Spark" Gabrielverbe walked back up the communication trench to V-F1, slower than before, but on his own feet.
gavin_cipowski: "You're late," said the corporal when Norbert Cipowski arrived on Day 9. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

Norbert Cipowski reached up to fix a sandbag at S-R3 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Ulrich Tym of the Hegemony (@ty_m1015). Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Norbert Cipowski kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

The medic looked at Norbert Cipowski's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to S-R3. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows. The clerk counted the names twice. Norbert Cipowski is number 977 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Norbert Cipowski looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Norbert Cipowski. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer.
Norbert Cipowski measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together.
Norbert Cipowski tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.
Norbert Cipowski remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped.

The men at S-R3 heard Norbert Cipowski call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Clement Asmodeus of the Hegemony (@asmodeus2008). Norbert Cipowski fired at a movement across the wire at S-R3. The man went down: Arno Zag, badly wounded.
greater.romania: The sergeant gave Leopold Romania a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 9 or any other.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Leopold Romania wrote to an old father who runs the family shop alone that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

In the rear quarters, Leopold Romania played football against the sappers. The ball was a sandbag stuffed with straw. The sappers cheated. The clerk counted the names twice. Leopold Romania is number 797 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In R-R10, Leopold Romania listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
A football came over the parapet from the Concord side with Leopold Romania's name scratched on it. Lucien Somehowballi kicked it back. It did not come again.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Leopold Romania in the open at R-R10. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Karel Freddie of the Hegemony (@0__freddie__0). Leopold Romania fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Emil "Button" Mugginsthede was grazed, and that rifle did not fire again tonight. Leopold Romania was killed outright at R-R10, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Karel Freddie of the Hegemony (@0__freddie__0).
The House of Romania sent Dorian "Ghost" Romania after Leopold Romania. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
The village shop had three kinds of soap. Dorian "Ghost" Romania stood at the counter far longer than the purchase required.

A bullet hit Dorian "Ghost" Romania in the neck at R-R10. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Marek Berkaatilla of the Hegemony (@berkaatilla). Dorian "Ghost" Romania looked over the parapet at R-R10 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Marek Berkaatilla of the Hegemony (@berkaatilla).
Konrad Romania came to the front because his brother Dorian "Ghost" Romania never came home. He carries a lucky button.

A bullet hit Konrad Romania in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at R-R10. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Bastian "Smokes" Goyhenetche of the Hegemony (@elliott_goyhenetche).
ilovturnip28ybarry: In Varenne, Jonas Ybarry was a baker. In S-C15, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a baker again.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Jonas Ybarry read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Jonas Ybarry aimed a step ahead and fired: Benedikt Nicolassuess, gravely wounded. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Jonas Ybarry answered to number 722. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Jonas Ybarry kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Jonas Ybarry's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket.
A loose thread in Jonas Ybarry's blanket turned out to be very long. By the time he stopped pulling, there was a hole to explain.
A second spoon disappeared. Jonas Ybarry searched the washing area and found a gap behind the board where everyone left cutlery to dry.

A round came through the loophole Jonas Ybarry was watching at S-C15 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Viktor Noobly of the Hegemony (@noobly97). Jonas Ybarry stood up to fix a loose sandbag at S-C15. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Viktor Noobly of the Hegemony (@noobly97).
Zeno "Ghost" Ybarry took the same post at S-C15 where Jonas Ybarry stood. He found his father's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
Bastian "Ghost" Kgss and Zeno "Ghost" Ybarry argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.
isaac_jpez: Silas Jpez walked into W-F10 on Day 14 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
A bullet hit the sandbag beside Silas Jpez. He ducked, and noticed his hands were shaking. He kept working anyway.
Silas Jpez came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot.
lukehomeless: Matthias Lukehomeless joined the replacements on Day 10. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.

Matthias Lukehomeless made a list of things to buy on leave. It started with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into U-F15. Matthias Lukehomeless has learned to walk bent double.

Matthias Lukehomeless felt a hard tug at his hip at U-F15. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Roland Seallesak of the Hegemony (@seallesak). A letter from home found Matthias Lukehomeless before the night shift. Matthias Lukehomeless folded it small and kept it close.

A round came through the loophole Matthias Lukehomeless was watching at U-F15 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Pavel "Shadow" Yarrito of the Hegemony (@joey_yarrito). A single shot at U-F15. Matthias Lukehomeless sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Pavel "Shadow" Yarrito of the Hegemony (@joey_yarrito).
The papers connected Severin "Brick" Lukehomeless to Matthias Lukehomeless. The men took longer to learn Severin "Brick" Lukehomeless's own habits, but they made the effort.
Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Severin "Brick" Lukehomeless read a theatre review while peeling supper.
A shell hit the latrine at U-F15. Nobody was hurt. Severin "Brick" Lukehomeless says it was the best day of the war.

Severin "Brick" Lukehomeless took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at U-F15, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Roland Seallesak of the Hegemony (@seallesak).
matteozrybak: Edmund Matteozrybak came up the line in the rain with a cracked shaving mirror and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
First Wave. Edmund Matteozrybak signed when the posters were still wet. He keeps the ribbon wrapped in oilcloth with a cracked shaving mirror.
Edmund Matteozrybak left the work of a rifleman to become a machine gunner. Someone from the old section came over to see how it was going.
A man asked Edmund Matteozrybak to describe Saint-Lune without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch.
Edmund Matteozrybak wrote a letter for Silas Zdsh's mother, because Silas could not find the words. Silas signed it.

On a quiet night Marek Ham (Concord) and Edmund Matteozrybak (Hegemony) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there. The Concord won Verdel Ridge. In S-F11, Edmund Matteozrybak listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Machine-gun fire swept S-F11. Edmund Matteozrybak took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Yann Vee of the Concord (@ask._.vee). An orderly waved the bearers in: one bed, cleared and scrubbed. Edmund Matteozrybak was lifted onto it in the hospital dugout.
Edmund Matteozrybak finally has a bed in the hospital dugout. A real blanket, a lamp, and a surgeon who has not slept.
A bed came free in the hospital dugout, and Edmund Matteozrybak was carried in at last. Victory at Hill 304. Edmund Matteozrybak let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

There was never a bed for Edmund Matteozrybak, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to S-F11 on his own feet. A letter from home reached Edmund Matteozrybak before dusk. Edmund Matteozrybak read it twice and slept a little easier.
A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Edmund Matteozrybak lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing.
Brass cases piled up around Edmund Matteozrybak's boots at S-F11. Out of all those rounds, one found Dietrich Caydan, badly wounded.
Edmund Matteozrybak had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Wendel Yurboixav, grazed.

At S-F11 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Edmund Matteozrybak turned around and took a shovel blow. Pavel Tsanev of the Concord was already gone. Raider: Pavel Tsanev of the Concord (@vl.tsanev). Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Edmund Matteozrybak could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

A bullet went through Edmund Matteozrybak's upper arm at S-F11 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Florian "Doc" Raumeidechse of the Concord (@raumeidechse). Edmund Matteozrybak was killed on watch at S-F11. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Florian "Doc" Raumeidechse of the Concord (@raumeidechse).

The papers say Zeno Matteozrybak. The sergeant says he has his father's eyes. Edmund Matteozrybak's eyes. Nobody in S-F11 argues. Zeno Matteozrybak, volunteer number 14, received the First Wave ribbon. The quartermaster pronounced the name wrong; he corrected it for the record. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Zeno Matteozrybak watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Zeno Matteozrybak smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Wendel "Mole" Day came out for a cup and was badly wounded.

The enemy tried to rush a supply sled across the open ground. Zeno Matteozrybak was faster. Hugo "Owl" Guy was grazed. A letter from home reached Zeno Matteozrybak before dusk. Zeno Matteozrybak read it twice and slept a little easier.

A bullet found Zeno Matteozrybak at S-F11, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Quentin "Ash" Provadabro of the Concord (@provadabro). Zeno Matteozrybak looked over the parapet at S-F11 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Quentin "Ash" Provadabro of the Concord (@provadabro).
Leopold Matteozrybak asked about Zeno Matteozrybak on arriving at S-F11. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.

The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Leopold Matteozrybak fished it out by feel and then had to wash again. A letter from home reached Leopold Matteozrybak before dusk. Leopold Matteozrybak read it twice and slept a little easier.

Leopold Matteozrybak was on the dawn watch at S-F11 when the Concord raiders came. A club, a shout, and Leopold Matteozrybak was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Bram Kochek of the Concord (@thicc_kochek).
nsrr_007: Nobody asked Konrad Nsrr why he came. Nobody in R-F21 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.

Konrad Nsrr wrote to a mother who sets a place for him at every meal. He did not mention the shelling. He mentioned the stars. A letter from home reached Konrad Nsrr before dusk. Konrad Nsrr read it twice and slept a little easier.

A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Konrad Nsrr. The men named it Old Tom and said it had chosen him. A letter from home reached Konrad Nsrr before dusk. Konrad Nsrr read it twice and slept a little easier. Hill 304 is lost. Konrad Nsrr heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Konrad Nsrr laughed at something nobody else had heard. Asked to share it, he admitted remembering a conversation from years ago.
Old Tom the crow follows Konrad Nsrr along the trench now. When Old Tom flies off, men duck. They are usually right to.

Konrad Nsrr raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F21. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Jonas "Doc" Angelogia of the Hegemony (@angelogia55). Dawn watch. Konrad Nsrr put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Jonas Hill, gravely wounded.
The wound on Konrad Nsrr's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-F21 and grazed Konrad Nsrr's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Karel Engel of the Hegemony (@honey_.engel). On dawn watch at R-F21, Konrad Nsrr fired at a shadow by the enemy wire. The shadow was Clement Hs, now grazed. The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Konrad Nsrr looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Konrad Nsrr returned to R-F21 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Konrad Nsrr is number 304. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Konrad Nsrr wrote to a mother who sets a place for him at every meal that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

A round went through the rim of Konrad Nsrr's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Clement Hs of the Hegemony (@13_h.s_54). An enemy patrol scattered in front of R-F21. Konrad Nsrr fired at the last man to run. Albin "Shadow" Bobthesnob was badly wounded.
The medic cut the last bandage off Konrad Nsrr's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to R-F21 the same hour.
Somebody in R-F21 wanted to shoot Old Tom for the pot. Konrad Nsrr stood in front of the rifle. The matter has been dropped.
A splinter opened Konrad Nsrr's cheek at R-F21. A medic stitched it on the spot and he was back on the fire step before the tea went cold.
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Konrad Nsrr is whole again, or near enough for the line.
passin_time669: Severin Time introduced himself as a choir singer from Greyhallow. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.

Severin Time pulled Rafael "Whistle" Nobody out of a flooded shell hole at the Ossuary Wood. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember. Victory at Grey Mill. Severin Time let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Severin Time's hands still remember being a choir singer's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world.
Part of the parapet collapsed near Severin Time. Repairs started as soon as the dust settled, with one man on watch while the rest worked.
For keeping his head when others lost theirs at the Brickworks, Severin Time was promoted to Lance Corporal.
At Saint-Ash crossroads, Jonas "Bones" Lasse and Severin Time exchanged rifle shots until a shell burst between the positions. For a while, both rifles remained silent.

Severin Time was carrying water up to Q-F22 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Severin Time did not. Shot by Bram "Whistle" Rob of the Concord (@rey_rob_ii). Severin Time spent the night on a stretcher in the trench behind the aid post. Every bed was taken.
punished_dumas: Bastian Dumas came up on Day 15 carrying news from Saint-Lune. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
Bastian Dumas offered a biscuit for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity.
rezasiibiil: The sergeant gave Benedikt Rezasiibiil a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 5 or any other.

Benedikt Rezasiibiil was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success. From Hill 304 the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Benedikt Rezasiibiil wrote to twin brothers too young to enlist that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Benedikt Rezasiibiil put a folded ration label under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal.
Benedikt Rezasiibiil and Quentin Underthrone sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.

Benedikt Rezasiibiil was hit in the forearm at S-F2. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Norbert "Ash" Kkrogheemil of the Hegemony (@kkrogheemil).
Benedikt Rezasiibiil walked back up the communication trench to S-F2, slower than before, but on his own feet.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Benedikt Rezasiibiil wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Benedikt Rezasiibiil traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch. The clerk counted the names twice. Benedikt Rezasiibiil is number 341 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached S-F2 with the rations. Benedikt Rezasiibiil ate while listening to the revised orders.

A round came through the loophole Benedikt Rezasiibiil was watching at S-F2 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Silas Kmec of the Hegemony (@rastislav_kmec). Benedikt Rezasiibiil looked over the parapet at S-F2 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Silas Kmec of the Hegemony (@rastislav_kmec).
The House of Rezasiibiil sent another. Marek "Lucky" Rezasiibiil, uncle of Benedikt Rezasiibiil, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
Marek "Lucky" Rezasiibiil caught a falling mug with his boot. Nobody could say if it was skill or luck, and he did not say either.
At S-F2 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Marek "Lucky" Rezasiibiil won the bet. Silas Kmec was grazed.

A bullet hit Marek "Lucky" Rezasiibiil in the neck at S-F2. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Leopold Fwtx of the Hegemony (@fwtx_p4y0n). A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Marek "Lucky" Rezasiibiil aimed a step ahead and fired: Konrad "Owl" Kino, badly wounded. Marek "Lucky" Rezasiibiil was killed on watch at S-F2. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Leopold Fwtx of the Hegemony (@fwtx_p4y0n).
Teodor "Lucky" Rezasiibiil came to the front because his uncle Marek "Lucky" Rezasiibiil never came home. He carries a cracked shaving mirror.
Teodor "Lucky" Rezasiibiil wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.
sechpabra: On the way to N-F6, Florian Sechpabra tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Florian Sechpabra. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer.
Florian Sechpabra taught Ulrich Olotro three words in the language of home. Ulrich uses all three at the wrong moment, every day.
wallstercorner: Pavel Wallstercorn walked into S-C5 on Day 9 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Pavel Wallstercorn wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Pavel Wallstercorn tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Pavel Wallstercorn is number 744. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into S-C5. Pavel Wallstercorn has learned to walk bent double.
A round went through the rim of Pavel Wallstercorn's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Clement Asmodeus of the Hegemony (@asmodeus2008).

Pavel Wallstercorn took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at S-C5, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Norbert Sanocfc of the Hegemony (@sanocfc).
The bearers moved Pavel Wallstercorn's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule.
Pavel Wallstercorn survived the wound and the waiting. He is back at S-C5, and still will not talk about the nights outside the aid post.
Pavel Wallstercorn reads Matthias Gasmask's letters from home out loud, because Matthias never learned to read. Pavel leaves out the sad parts. Matthias knows.
willskeltonyea: Gideon Willskeltony reached S-R7 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.

Gideon Willskeltony was found at the bottom of the trench at S-R7, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Dorian "Saint" Dallas of the Hegemony (@dallas106931). Gideon Willskeltony was killed at S-R7 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Dorian "Saint" Dallas of the Hegemony (@dallas106931).
The House of Willskeltony sent Wendel Willskeltony after Gideon Willskeltony. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.

Wendel Willskeltony hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back. The clerk counted the names twice. Wendel Willskeltony is number 865 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Wendel Willskeltony stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Wendel Willskeltony had just lit a cigarette at S-R7 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Arno Toastyy of the Hegemony (@totally.am.toastyy).
